Class GameOverController

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.it.view.gui.controllers.GameOverController
public class GameOverController extends Object
Controller for the game-over screen.

Receives winners and final scores, fills the TableView, and highlights winner rows.

Also exposes setLeaderboard(String, int, int, int, int, List); when the server sends a LEADERBOARD message, it fills the lower table with the global leaderboard for games with the same player count and highlights the current player row.

      public void setLeaderboard(String recipient, int myScore, int myRank, int totalEntries, int numPlayers, List<LeaderboardEntry> leaderboard)
      Populates the lower table with the global leaderboard received from the server.
      Parameters:
      recipient - nickname of the current player, whose row is highlighted
      myScore - final score of the current player
      myRank - 1-based rank of the current player
      totalEntries - total recorded results for the given player count
      numPlayers - player count of the considered games
      leaderboard - global leaderboard, already sorted and ranked
